capabilities: Preview and present Marp slide decks from Markdown notes
Export decks as HTML, PDF, or PPTX via Marp CLI
Install bundled and custom Marp theme CSS
Convert Obsidian wiki-links and image embeds to Marp-compatible syntax
Add slide metadata, callouts, columns, and card grids via %%marp-*%% markers
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid diagram plugin; Mermaid rendering and auto-fit only apply to slide content.
extras: Security note: HTML exports may execute author-supplied scripts per Marp CLI --html behavior. Export requires a user-installed Marp CLI pinned to version 4.5.1; beta builds are available via BRAT. The bundled TsangerJinKai02 font may require a separate commercial license.
intentEvidence: Marp Extended originated from Samuele Cozzi's Marp Slides for Obsidian and is now maintained as an independent plugin project.
problem: Obsidian's core Slides feature has no Marp support, no presenter notes, and no direct HTML/PDF/PPTX deck export.

relations.evidence: Marp Extended originated from Samuele Cozzi's Marp Slides for Obsidian and is now maintained as an independent plugin project.
Export runs an external Marp CLI command, but passes the plugin's shipped marp-engine.cjs
we recommend using Marp Extended together with Pivi

requires.name: Marp CLI (or Node.js/npm for npx fallback)
Google Chrome, Chromium, or Microsoft Edge

summary: Slide deck plugin that previews, presents, and exports Marp presentations from Markdown notes, with custom themes, Mermaid diagrams, and extended syntax.
